capabilities: Open images in a lightbox from reading view
Zoom in, out, and reset with buttons or mouse wheel
Drag to pan when zoomed in
Close with ESC, background click, or close button
extras: Manual installation only; no community plugin store listing mentioned in the README. A Chinese-language documentation link is referenced.
problem: Obsidian opens images and Mermaid diagrams at their rendered size, so large images and diagrams cannot be inspected closely in reading view.
summary: Lightbox viewer that opens images and Mermaid diagrams in a zoomable popup when clicked in reading view.
